WITH f AS (SELECT s.store_id, sale_date, sum(quantity) u_all, sum(case when not staff_purchase_flag then quantity else 0 end) u_nostaff, sum(net_amount) n_all, sum(case when not staff_purchase_flag then net_amount else 0 end) n_nostaff FROM fact_sales_line l JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) WHERE s.store_id=108 AND sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-01' AND DATE '2026-07-14' GROUP BY 1,2)
SELECT r.business_date, r.units_sold, f.u_all, f.u_nostaff, r.net_sales_before_returns, f.n_all, f.n_nostaff FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN f ON f.store_id=r.store_id AND f.sale_date=r.business_date ORDER BY 1

SELECT f.sale_date, f.receipt_id, f.line_no, f.sku_chk, f.quantity, f.staff_purchase_flag FROM (SELECT l.*, p.sku sku_chk FROM fact_sales_line l JOIN dim_product p USING(product_key) JOIN dim_store s USING(store_key) WHERE s.store_id=108 AND p.subcategory='Interior Paint' AND l.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-06-29' AND DATE '2026-08-02' AND (l.staff_purchase_flag OR l.quantity>=5)) f ORDER BY 1

SELECT s.store_id, s.store_name, 'Interior Paint' AS subcategory, d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period, sum(f.quantity) AS units_sold
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = f.sale_date
WHERE s.store_id = 108 AND p.subcategory = 'Interior Paint' AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2026/27' AND d.fiscal_period = 3
GROUP BY ALL
